note: Generated by tests/test_ai_combat_math_property.gd --write-catalogue at the harness default rules edition (11e), fast tier, 1500 seeded Monte-Carlo samples per pair, then every `why` written by hand. Each entry is a REPRODUCED divergence between AIDecisionMaker's expected-damage arithmetic and what RulesEngine resolves, with the predicted/resolved ratio measured on the harness's open-ground duel (terrain neutralised, ranged 4in centre-to-centre so unengaged and in half range, one W120 defender so nothing saturates). Every surviving entry is a real, isolated, edition-independent estimator gap or a named engine bug (`cause`): twin-linked, anti-union, anti+devastating-wounds, dice-valued-strength. This file is a RATCHET, not an excuse: a pair that is NOT listed must agree within 10% (or 3 SE), and a listed pair fails if its error flips to the other side of 1.0 or grows, in log space, more than 15% beyond the recorded ratio.
